name: φX174 sequence report
summary: Sanger's team reported the roughly 5,375-letter DNA sequence of the virus φX174 in 1977, revealing that some of its genes overlap.
description: A reported approximately 5,375-nucleotide φX174 sequence, obtained with plus/minus sequencing, revealed overlapping coding regions.
